description.name: Entry
description.text: Fifteen single attacks (1.50 each), grants [Attach Fire 3 with Stacking], [Synchro Mode], [Damage Cap +10000] and [Fire's Revelation Mode] to the user

description.name: Attach Fire 3 with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Fire Level by 3 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Fire 3

description.name: Synchro Mode
description.text: Replaces the Attack and Defend commands

description.name: Fire's Revelation Mode
description.text: Fire abilities deal 30% more damage, increases the damage/healing cap by 10000, Fire abilities trigger 1 additional time, removed after casting three Fire abilities, removed if the character hasn't [Synchro Mode]
